info.name: Petso - Production (Vercel)
info.description:
Postman collection for **https://petso-api.vercel.app** (signup is pre-verified).
**Roles:** farmer | vet | company | admin
Run `python tools/build_postman_collection.py` to regenerate.

request.description:
**Production (Vercel)** — المتغير `base_url` الافتراضي: `https://petso-api.vercel.app`
1. التسجيل يفعّل الحساب مباشرة (`is_verified`) — لا يوجد verify-email / OTP.
2. سجّل الدخول أو أنشئ حسابًا ثم تابع المجلدات.
3. حساب الـ demo المضمّن مع SQLite: `admin_email` / `admin_password` (انظر `deployment/README.md`) — نفسها لـ `/admin/`.
4. حدّث `category_id`, `product_id`, … من ردود الطلبات.
5. حذف جماعي (staff): `DELETE .../ecommerce/products/delete-all/` و `.../categories/delete-all/` — يحتاج مستخدم **`is_staff`** (مثلاً تسجيل دخول Admin المضمّن أو superuser).

**Variables:** base_url, admin_*, role emails/passwords, tokens, *_id

item.name: 01 - Authentication

request.description: Creates farmer account; `is_verified` is true — login with JWT immediately.
Superuser shipped in `deployment/petso.sqlite3` when `DATABASE_URL` is unset. Same `admin_email` / `admin_password` work for Django `/admin/`.
Returns the logged-in user's profile: id, email, name, phone_number, role, is_verified, date_joined. Requires Bearer token (any role).

item.description: JWT: Login requests save access_token and refresh_token to collection variables.

request.description: No authentication needed. Returns all farmer profiles.
As **farmer**, omit `farmer` — the server assigns your profile from the JWT. As **admin**, include `farmer` (FarmerProfile PK). Run **Create farmer profile** first if new user.
DELETE /api/farmers/profile/{{farmer_profile_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/farmers/flocks/{{flock_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
No authentication needed. Returns all vet profiles.

item.name: Bulk delete — staff JWT

request.description:
**DRF `IsAdminUser`** — Django user must have **`is_staff=True`**. Use **Login - Admin** or locally run `python manage.py createsuperuser`. API Register with `role=admin` does **not** set `is_staff`.

Removes every product; images, reviews, cart line items CASCADE. Categories unchanged.

Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

exec: console.log('Delete all products: deleted count =', j.deleted);

request.description:
Removes every category; products CASCADE.

Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

exec: console.log('Delete all categories: deleted count =', j.deleted);

request.description:
Removes every ProductImage row. Products remain.

Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

Removes every Cart (and its CartItems CASCADE).

Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

item.description: Destructive admin endpoints. Bearer token must be from a **staff** user (`is_staff=True`). Order: delete products before categories to avoid CASCADE surprises.

request.description: Body **form-data**: product fields as **Text**; `image` = **File** (Select Files). Same pattern as **Create post**. Leave extra headers empty. Optional: omit `image` if you add images later via JSON or product-images.
Alternative: JSON with `images_data` (remote_image_url per row). For a local file use **Create product** (form-data + `image` File).

body.raw:
{
  "company": "{{company_profile_id}}",
  "category": "{{category_id}}",
  "sku": "SKU-JSON-{{$timestamp}}",
  "name": "Starter Feed 25kg (remote image)",
  "description": "High protein starter for broilers",
  "unit_price": "450.00",
  "currency": "EGP",
  "stock": 200,
  "is_active": true,
  "requires_prescription": false,

    {
      "remote_image_url": "https://placehold.co/200x200/png",
      "alt_text": "Main",
      "position": 0
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Requires authenticated user (e.g. farmer).
DELETE /api/ecommerce/categories/{{category_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/ecommerce/products/{{product_id}}/ — 204 No Content. Images CASCADE.
DELETE /api/ecommerce/product-images/{{product_image_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/ecommerce/cart/{{cart_id}}/ — 204 No Content. Cart items CASCADE.

item.description: Typical order: Login Company → Create company profile → Create category → **Create product** (form-data + `image` File), or JSON alternate / POST /ecommerce/product-images/. Then Login Farmer → Cart add_item. Folder **Bulk delete — staff JWT**: `DELETE .../products/delete-all/` and `DELETE .../categories/delete-all/` (needs `is_staff`; see request descriptions).

request.description: Serializer may mark total as read-only; adjust backend if create fails.
DELETE /api/orders/orders/{{order_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
No auth required. Filter by vet user_id: `?vet={{vet_user_id}}`. Filter available: `?is_available=true`. Filter by date: `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.
Filter slots by vet **user_id** (the `user_id` returned at login). No auth required. Also supports `?is_available=true` and `?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.
Login as **vet**. `vet` is assigned automatically from JWT — do not include it in body. Run **Create vet profile** first.
Vet marks their slot as unavailable (or any field update).
Set slot_id from **Add slot** or **List all slots**.

Vet changes the appointment status. Login as **vet**.

Allowed values: `accepted`, `finished`, `rejected`.

Staff can also set `scheduled` or `cancelled`.

Response: full appointment object with updated status.
DELETE /api/medical/slots/{{slot_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/medical/appointments/{{appointment_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/medical/prescriptions/{{prescription_id}}/ — 204 No Content.

Default flow: Body **form-data**. `content` = **Text**; `image` = **File** (Select Files). Same pattern as **Create product**. If Postman shows a **yellow warning** on the filename, re-pick the file. Leave headers empty. On VPS, nginx: `client_max_body_size 10m;` for `/api/`.
Alternative: JSON with `remote_image_url` (server downloads). For a **local file**, use **Create post** (form-data + `image` File).
Optional fallback only if multipart is blocked. Prefer **Create post** (form-data + File).

Toggle like on a post. First call **likes** the post; second call **unlikes** it. Response: `{ "liked": true/false, "likes_count": <int> }`. Requires Bearer token. The post list also returns `is_liked_by_me` and `likes_count`.
DELETE /api/social/posts/{{post_id}}/ — 204 No Content. Comments and likes CASCADE.
DELETE /api/social/comments/{{comment_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
User PK integers from Django admin / shell.
DELETE /api/chat/chats/{{chat_id}}/ — 204 No Content. Messages CASCADE.
DELETE /api/chat/messages/{{message_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/ai/cases/{{case_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
Set farmer_user_id to the authenticated user's PK (Django User id).
Requires is_staff user token.
DELETE /api/auth/profile/{{user_id}}/ — 204 No Content. Staff only. Linked farmer/vet/company profiles CASCADE.
DELETE /api/auth/notifications/{{user_id}}/ — 204 No Content.
DELETE /api/auth/activity/{{user_id}}/ — 204 No Content.

item.name: 14 - Admin: Delete All

request.description:
**Staff only (`is_staff=True`).** `DELETE {{base_url}}/api/auth/profile/delete-all/` — deletes every row in the table. Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

⚠️ This also deletes all linked profiles (farmer, vet, company) via CASCADE.
**Staff only (`is_staff=True`).** `DELETE {{base_url}}/api/auth/notifications/delete-all/` — deletes every row in the table. Response: `200` `{ "deleted": <int> }`.

exec: console.log('Delete all notification preferences: deleted =', j.deleted);

item.description:
One `DELETE .../delete-all/` per table. All require a **staff JWT** (`is_staff=True`). Login as a superuser (`python manage.py createsuperuser`) then use **Login - Admin**.

⚠️ These are **irreversible**. Use with care.
